name: Nigrescent-Bergschrund
description: Dust finer than flour pools in the low places, swallowing craters to their rims. Nothing has disturbed an orbital debris ring in a million years, and the dust keeps its surface smooth as held breath.
Standing still, you feel the temperate air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
There is money in uranium and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
